title: Grateful Dead Live at Alpine Valley Music Theatre on 1989-07-17
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.8 MHz) >KORG AudioGate 4 > Adobe Audition CC 2015 > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24
source: Ultra Matrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90)

ai_review.summary: Clear matrix recording captures a stellar Uncle John’s Band with Brent Mydland’s soaring backing vocals.
ai_review.review: The UltraMatrix SBD source delivers a clean, well‑balanced sound that lets the performance shine. Reviewers rave about this show being their favorite Uncle John’s Band ever, highlighting Brent’s backing vox as a special touch. The recording is highly recommended for anyone looking to hear that magic moment.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review praises both the musical performance and implies good sound quality; with limited data we weight heavily toward the positive show impression while keeping confidence low.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific issues noted; UltraMatrix SBD generally provides clear, balanced audio that captures both band and ambience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: While the full setlist is unknown, reviewers describe the performance as memorable and energetic, with Uncle John’s Band standing out as a highlight.

band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's backing vocals are singled out for making the Uncle John's Band rendition special.
